find: return { padIndex, id: pad.id ?? '', mapping: pad.mapping ?? '', axes, buttons, support: classifyPad(pad) };
replace: return { padIndex, id: pad.id ?? '', mapping: pad.mapping ?? 'standard', axes, buttons, support: classifyPad(pad) };
killedBy: readPadDiagnostics leaves an unmapped pad unmapped rather than normalising it to standard
why: A pad the browser has NOT remapped is the whole subject of the compatibility report (issue #599). Defaulting the absent `mapping` to 'standard' makes the report state that the browser remapped a pad it did not -- the single most misleading sentence this feature could produce, and one a reader would act on. The line grew a `support` field under issue #596 and this find string moved with it; the mutation itself is unchanged.
